title: Synthesia’s AI training platform is moving beyond videos into live coaching
slides: Can Synthesia train your team without videos?
Its avatars now respond to you in real time.
But live coaching demands more than a scripted face.
Your employees will practice sales calls with an AI.
Test it today on a real, unprompted conversation.
thread_text:
1. Are avatars enough?

Synthesia’s AI now responds in real time—yet your team still lacks the feedback only a human coach gives.

2. Scripted faces fall flat.

Live coaching reads micro-expressions and adjusts mid-sentence. An avatar? It follows a script, not your employee’s hesitation.

3. Practice for real stakes.

Your sales team will run calls against this AI—but unprompted conversations reveal gaps no script can hide.

4. The twist in training.

Employees get confident on rehearsed lines, then freeze when the prospect interrupts. That’s the hole Synthesia can’t fill.

5. Test a live call today.

Run one unprompted conversation with your own team—does the avatar catch their stumbles, or just nod?
